prompt_used:
Redraw the subject as an analytical cubist portrait — the head and shoulders fractured into faceted planes showing the face from several viewpoints at once, profile and full-face folded into one shifting surface. Every feature still appears somewhere: both eyes, the nose, the mouth, the jawline, the hair — recombined across the planes rather than erased. Confident charcoal edges outline each facet. A restrained Braque palette of warm ochre, muted grey-green, umber and soft tan, light and shadow shifting independently across the planes. Likeness survives in the features and their character, not in a single viewpoint. Frame from mid-chest to the top of the head. No lettering. No held objects — no cups, glasses, phones, books, tools, watches or eyewear. Worn jewellery is fine: necklaces, earrings, piercings.

Avoid dropping any feature, a single photorealistic viewpoint, garish colour, or smooth untextured surfaces.
